page_title: AUG 0-3 WER | Augsburg v Werder Bremen 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 13:16 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is on for Senne Lynen.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 3 Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) scores a beautiful goal. He climbs high to meet a cross and finds the back of the net with a bullet header that goes into the bottom left corner.
88' The substitution is prepared. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nick Woltemade.
87' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
85' 6:5 – the corner kicks stats.
82' Tobias Welz interrupts the game. One of the players from Werder Bremen won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
80' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Marvin Ducksch and he is replaced by Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
79' Substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt leaves the pitch and is replaced by Christian Gross (Werder Bremen).
77' A cross from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
76' Augsburg concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
73' The ball is out of play and Augsburg manage to earn a corner.
72' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Arne Maier is replaced by Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dion Beljo (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Kristijan Jakic can be given a rest.
70' A dangerous towering header by Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
69' The ball is out of play. Augsburg win a corner kick.
68' The corner from Arne Maier (Augsburg) is cleared away by the defence.
65' A dangerous looking corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared to safety by the defence.
64' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Yellow card. Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
61' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Pep Biel (Augsburg) replaces Ruben Vargas.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sven Michel (Augsburg) will replace Phillip Tietz.
61' 0 - 2 Goal! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Finn Dahmen into the bottom left corner.
60' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is going to take the penalty!
59' Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) jumps into a tackle and Tobias Welz signals a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Werder Bremen!!
58' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
57' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' The Augsburg players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
52' 0 - 1 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Marvin Ducksch and Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) gets in a shot, sending the ball into the top of the net. 0:1.

51' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
50' Werder Bremen players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' Substitution. Arne Engels makes his way off the pitch and Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 53:47 – the latest ball possession ratio.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
44' Arne Maier (Augsburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
43' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
41' Some patient build-up play from Augsburg as they look to unlock the defence.
37' Werder Bremen have a goal ruled out for offside!
33' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
31' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner which is cleared.
30' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:4.
27' Augsburg keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
25' A cross from a corner kick by Werder Bremen is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
23' A player from Werder Bremen commits a rough challenge. Tobias Welz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

19' Finn Dahmen pulls off a decent save! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
18' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
15' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Tobias Welz stops the game and makes a call.
13' Ball possession – 42:58.
10' Goal, no wait, Augsburg have a goal disallowed due to a foul.
8' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
5' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.
3' There's an opportunity for Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tobias Welz.
